description: RF-601..RF-604, RF-621: the planner's two answers for the hand-off package of the planning integration test. First the plan: requirements that cite supported cards, one that cites a card with no supported claim and an unknown id, one holding hostile Markdown and HTML, an entity mapping without a supported card, and a task in a phase that does not exist. The two tasks that are kept state an invariant, a risk class, the guards they add and review probes (RF-630, RF-635). Second the product requirements document: features that cite FEAT cards (one a card with no supported claim, one holding hostile Markdown and HTML), rules that cite BR cards (one citing a FEAT card), an out-of-scope item, and a role and a non-functional item holding hostile Markdown and HTML. Written by hand for the fake provider; no real provider was called.
